import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Titanic Passenger Survival Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Survival rate by class and sex
survival_by_class_sex = df.groupby(['class', 'sex'])['survived'].mean().reset_index()
survival_pivot = survival_by_class_sex.pivot(index='class', columns='sex', values='survived')
class_order = ['First', 'Second', 'Third']
survival_pivot = survival_pivot.reindex(class_order)
survival_pivot.plot(kind='bar', ax=axes[0, 0], color=['#FF69B4', '#4169E1'])
axes[0, 0].set_title('Survival Rate by Class and Sex', fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Passenger Class')
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
axes[0, 0].set_xticklabels(class_order, rotation=45)
axes[0, 0].legend(title='Sex', labels=['Female', 'Male'])
axes[0, 0].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 2. Age distribution by survival
axes[0, 1].hist([df[df['survived']==0]['age'].dropna(), 
                 df[df['survived']==1]['age'].dropna()], 
                bins=20, label=['Did not survive', 'Survived'], 
                color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'], alpha=0.7)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Age Distribution by Survival', fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Age (years)')
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Number of Passengers')
axes[0, 1].legend()
axes[0, 1].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Survival count by embarkation point
embark_survival = df.groupby(['embark_town', 'survived']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
embark_survival = embark_survival[embark_survival.sum(axis=1) > 0].sort_values(by=1, ascending=False)
embark_survival.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=axes[1, 0], 
                     color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'], width=0.7)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Passenger Count by Embarkation Town', fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Embarkation Town')
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Number of Passengers')
axes[1, 0].set_xticklabels(axes[1, 0].get_xticklabels(), rotation=45)
axes[1, 0].legend(title='Survival', labels=['Did not survive', 'Survived'])
axes[1, 0].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 4. Fare distribution by class with survival overlay
for pclass, class_name in enumerate(['First', 'Second', 'Third'], 1):
    class_data = df[df['class'] == class_name]
    survived_data = class_data[class_data['survived'] == 1]['fare']
    died_data = class_data[class_data['survived'] == 0]['fare']
    
    axes[1, 1].scatter(died_data, [pclass-0.1]*len(died_data), alpha=0.4, 
                       color='#FF6B6B', s=20, label='Did not survive' if pclass == 1 else '')
    axes[1, 1].scatter(survived_data, [pclass+0.1]*len(survived_data), alpha=0.4, 
                       color='#4ECDC4', s=20, label='Survived' if pclass == 1 else '')

axes[1, 1].set_title('Fare Distribution by Class and Survival', fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Fare (£)')
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Passenger Class')
axes[1, 1].set_yticks([1, 2, 3])
axes[1, 1].set_yticklabels(['First', 'Second', 'Third'])
axes[1, 1].legend(loc='upper right')
axes[1, 1].grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)
axes[1, 1].set_xlim(-5, df['fare'].quantile(0.95))

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
